t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:mp"></part-ref>是一条证明规则：一个输入接 A → B，另一个接 A，输出 B。
t.en: The new part <part-ref to="part:mp"></part-ref> is a proof rule: one input takes A → B, the other A, and it outputs B.

t.zh: 元件从上方的元件栏放到板上。输入对不上时，元件会显示它要的和收到的。
t.en: Parts go onto the board from the tray above. When an input does not fit, the part shows what it wants and what it got.

after.zh: 这条规则在逻辑学里叫肯定前件式（modus ponens）。

hint.zh: 先只看「下雨 → 地湿」和「下雨」。
hint.en: Look first at just “it rains → the ground is wet” and “it rains”.

hint.zh: 套用的输出和已知一样，也能接进别的元件。
hint.en: An Apply’s output, like a given, can go into another part.

step.en: A given you do not need

hint.zh: 从目标倒着想：哪一句能给出「我很开心」？
hint.en: Work back from the goal: which sentence can give “I am happy”?
